subject: Geopolitics
title: The Russia–China Axis
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Russia–China Axis.

hook.text: Putin and Xi declared a 'no limits' partnership in 2022. Two weeks later Russia invaded Ukraine. China watched.

buildup.text: Russia and China share opposition to US dominance. Together they coordinate at the UN, in trade, and in military drills.

discovery.text: The axis is transactional, not ideological. Each uses the other to balance American power, not to build a shared vision.

twist.text: China won't sacrifice its economy for Russia. It limits support just enough to avoid Western sanctions on itself.

climax.text: If the axis deepens into a formal alliance the West faces two great power adversaries simultaneously. That's the fear.

punchline.text: A partnership without limits still has boundaries.

quiz.question: Why is the Russia-China partnership considered transactional?
options: Both nations share the same political ideology
Each uses the other to balance US power, not to build shared vision
They have a formal mutual defense treaty
